subject: general
question: Who is the Chief Minister of Gujarat, as of January 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is **Bhupendra Patel**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bhupendra Patel** was sworn in as the Chief Minister of Gujarat on 13th September 2021.
 
• He succeeded **Vijay Rupani**, who resigned from the position.
 
• Bhupendra Patel is a member of the **Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)**.
 
• Before becoming the Chief Minister, he was a Member of the Legislative Assembly (MLA) from the **Ghatlodia constituency**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

The Chief Minister of Gujarat is the head of the government in the Indian state of Gujarat. The role involves overseeing the executive branch of the state government, implementing state policies, and ensuring the smooth functioning of the state administration.

 
 

 Position
 Description
 
 
 
 

 Chief Minister
 The head of the state government responsible for policy-making and administration.
 
 

 Governor
 The constitutional head of the state who appoints the Chief Minister.
 
 

 Legislative Assembly
 A body of elected representatives who make laws and policies for the state.
 
 

 Cabinet
 A group of senior ministers selected by the Chief Minister to assist in governance.
 
 

 Constituency
 A geographical area represented by an elected official in the Legislative Assembly.
